modelConflictTheme: Death fright or fear of dying
activePhase: The model describes alveolar cell growth or nodules, often with few symptoms.
healingPhase: The model describes cough, sputum, possible blood, and night sweats.
safetyNote: Respiratory symptoms, blood in sputum, unexplained weight change, and night sweats require medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Starvation or fear of lacking
activePhase: The model describes liver cell growth.
healingPhase: The model describes night sweats, fatigue, and tenderness.

modelConflictTheme: Existence, abandonment, or ‘refugee’ conflict
activePhase: The model describes fluid retention, reduced urine, and weight gain.
healingPhase: The model describes increased urine output and night sweats.

modelConflictTheme: Can’t digest the morsel
activePhase: The model describes glandular growth and fullness.
healingPhase: The model describes nausea, discomfort, and possible bleeding.
safetyNote: Gastrointestinal bleeding requires urgent medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Can’t digest the morsel or starvation
activePhase: The model describes glandular growth.
healingPhase: The model describes diarrhoea, cramping, and possible blood.
safetyNote: Blood in stool requires medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: An ugly or indigestible situation; inability to eliminate something vile
activePhase: The model describes glandular growth and possible obstruction.
healingPhase: The model describes diarrhoea, mucus, discharge, or bleeding.
safetyNote: Obstruction, rectal bleeding, or blood in stool requires medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Anxiety-anger or a fight over the morsel
activePhase: The model describes glandular growth and more enzyme output.
healingPhase: The model describes digestive upset and fatty stool.

modelConflictTheme: Can’t get the morsel fast enough
activePhase: The model describes tissue growth and increased hormone output.
healingPhase: The model describes swelling and tenderness.
safetyNote: New thyroid swelling or persistent neck symptoms require medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Can’t catch or swallow a morsel; can’t catch an ‘auditory morsel’ such as news
activePhase: The model describes tissue or mucosal growth.
healingPhase: The model describes tonsillitis-type swelling or ear inflammation/discharge.

modelConflictTheme: Ugly genital or procreation conflict
activePhase: The model describes glandular growth.
healingPhase: The model describes discharge and night sweats.
safetyNote: New pelvic symptoms, bleeding, discharge, or a palpable mass require medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Attack on integrity; feeling soiled or disfigured
activePhase: The model describes thickening or pigmented/raised growths.
healingPhase: The model describes inflammation, weeping, and itch.
safetyNote: Changing skin lesions require prompt medical review.

modelConflictTheme: Nest worry or an argument involving someone in the nest
activePhase: The model describes glandular growth or a lump.
healingPhase: The model describes swelling, tenderness, and night sweats.
safetyNote: New breast lumps require prompt medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Attack against the chest or heart
activePhase: The model describes pleural or pericardial thickening.
healingPhase: The model describes effusion, breathlessness, or pain.
safetyNote: Chest pain and breathlessness are urgent medical presentations.

modelConflictTheme: Attack against the abdomen or an ugly, underhand conflict
activePhase: The model describes thickening.
healingPhase: The model describes ascites, abdominal swelling, or discomfort.
safetyNote: New abdominal swelling or ascites requires prompt medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Self-devaluation related to region, performance, or ability
activePhase: The model describes bone or cartilage loss.
healingPhase: The model describes pain, swelling, heat, stiffness, or bone rebuilding.
safetyNote: Bone pain, swelling, or anaemia need medical assessment; do not describe them as a healing phase.

modelConflictTheme: Self-devaluation about strength or capability
activePhase: The model describes muscle wasting.
healingPhase: The model describes muscle pain and swelling.
safetyNote: New or progressive weakness requires medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Self-devaluation about a specific movement or task
activePhase: The model describes tissue loss.
healingPhase: The model describes tendon or ligament pain and inflammation.

modelConflictTheme: Mild self-devaluation in the related region
activePhase: The model describes tissue loss.
healingPhase: The model describes swollen, tender lymph nodes.
safetyNote: Swollen lymph nodes require medical assessment when new, persistent, or unexplained.

modelConflictTheme: Self-devaluation related to the area supplied
activePhase: The model describes vessel-wall loss.
healingPhase: The model describes vessel-wall inflammation and swelling.

modelConflictTheme: Fluid or water conflict
activePhase: The model describes tissue loss and a linked blood-pressure rise.
healingPhase: The model describes cyst formation.
safetyNote: Raised blood pressure, kidney symptoms, or a suspected cyst require medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Loss of a loved person or animal
activePhase: The model describes tissue loss.
healingPhase: The model describes swelling or a cyst.
safetyNote: Testicular or ovarian swelling requires medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Bleeding or injury conflict
activePhase: The model describes low platelets.
healingPhase: The model describes an enlarged spleen.
safetyNote: Low platelets, unexplained bleeding, or splenic enlargement require medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Going the wrong way or being off track
activePhase: The model describes reduced output and fatigue.
healingPhase: The model describes restored output.

modelConflictTheme: Territorial loss; sexual frustration or not being ‘taken’
activePhase: The model describes lining ulceration and angina/rhythm change.
healingPhase: The model describes swelling and a crisis described as heart attack or rhythm disturbance.
safetyNote: Chest pain, angina, or rhythm disturbance require emergency medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Territorial fear or scare; fright or shock
activePhase: The model describes lining ulceration, dry cough, or voice change.
healingPhase: The model describes bronchitis-type inflammation, asthma, laryngitis, or laryngeal spasm.
safetyNote: Breathlessness, asthma, or persistent voice change need medical assessment; severe breathing difficulty is an emergency.

tissueOrFunction: Stomach lesser curvature / bile ducts / pancreatic ducts / bladder lining
modelConflictTheme: Territorial or identity anger; inability to mark or organise one’s territory
activePhase: The model describes lining ulceration, pain, or function change.
healingPhase: The model describes inflammation, bile blockage/jaundice, or cystitis-type inflammation.
safetyNote: Jaundice and blood in urine require medical assessment.

tissueOrFunction: Rectum lining / cervix and vagina / thyroid ducts
modelConflictTheme: Not knowing where one belongs; sexual conflict; powerlessness or inability to act fast enough
activePhase: The model describes lining ulceration or widening/function change.
healingPhase: The model describes haemorrhoids or bleeding, rebuilding/inflammation, and swelling.
safetyNote: Rectal bleeding, vaginal bleeding, or new thyroid swelling requires medical assessment.

tissueOrFunction: Epidermis / periosteum / milk ducts / motor and sensory control
modelConflictTheme: Separation, unwanted/lost physical contact, or being unable to escape, hold on, or move
activePhase: The model describes dry/rough/numb skin, reduced sensation, or weakness of related muscles.
healingPhase: The model describes rash, redness, itch, tingling, sensitivity, twitching, cramp, or seizure.
safetyNote: New weakness, numbness, seizure, or sensory loss require neurological or medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Fear from behind; inability to believe what is heard; aversion to a situation
activePhase: The model describes reduced vision, hearing reduction, or lining ulceration.
healingPhase: The model describes visual disturbance, tinnitus, or a runny/congested nose.
safetyNote: New visual loss or hearing change requires medical assessment.

modelConflictTheme: Fear-disgust or resistance/fighting against something
activePhase: The model describes reduced glucagon with low blood sugar, or reduced insulin with high blood sugar.
healingPhase: The model describes restored output.
safetyNote: Blood-sugar disturbance requires medical assessment and must not be attributed to a model phase.
